prompt.project_info: High-resolution digital full-body mirror selfie of three original adult women standing side by side in a neutral modern hotel room, with realistic skin tones, slight mirror texture and soft indoor shadows.
prompt.main_subject: Three clearly adult women with original non-celebrity identities and neutral deadpan expressions. The left woman, center woman and right woman should remain visually distinct while sharing a casual group presence. The center woman holds the phone for the mirror selfie. Do not reproduce Sadie Sink, Natalia Dyer, Millie Bobby Brown or any other public figures.
prompt.composition_elements: Arrange the three adult women side by side in a vertical full-body mirror selfie. Dress all three in coordinated blue-and-deep-red vertically striped football kits with matching blue athletic shorts, striped team socks and white sneakers. Keep the jerseys free of recognizable club crests, sponsor marks or logos while preserving the team-kit color relationship. Set the scene in a neutral modern hotel room with gray accent wall, white bed and patterned beige-and-black carpet.
prompt.lighting_and_atmosphere: Use soft overhead hotel-room lighting with gentle shadows and realistic mirror reflection texture. Keep the mood casual, deadpan and candid, with all three subjects looking directly into the mirror.
prompt.technical_specs: High-resolution photorealistic digital photo, vertical full-body mirror selfie, natural smartphone perspective, realistic skin, fabric, carpet, bed and reflection detail, consistent proportions across all three adults, no text, logos or watermark.
